note: Floyd County Conservation Board park on the Little Cedar River ~2.5 mi W of Colwell (2962 140th St). Primitive camping on mown grass under mature trees beside the park's loop drive, with a picnic shelter, fire rings, playground and fishing access to the river, which lies 70-120 m west through woods. No pad lengths are posted, so whether a 23-ft motorhome can pull onto the grass sites is unconfirmed. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $10 primitive camping, no hookups, pit toilets, pressurized water, seasonal (no dates posted, dropped the note's ~May-Sep). Booking/FCFS not stated by the county (left as stored). Stays not waterfront; pin 140 m off (in the river woods at the bridge).
flags: FIT UNCLEAR, keep with caveat: the county says only 'Primitive camping under mature trees'; no pad or length information. On imagery the camping ground is open mown grass under scattered big trees west of a paved loop drive; the inclusion evidence's 'drive-in parking next to sites' came from The Dyrt. Proposed note carries the caveat.

WATERFRONT (confirms not waterfront): the Little Cedar here is about 13-21 m wide on Esri (240 m frame, under the ~30 m line, so creek-sized), and the camping grass is 70-120 m east of it behind continuous woods.

PIN 140 m off: 43.15555,-92.64480 is in the trees on the river bank by the 140th St bridge. Camping area centre is about 43.15500,-92.64327 (west of the loop, near the shelter at 43.15513,-92.64357 on the county's park map). Under the 250 m threshold, offered as an improvement.
